response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS excluded WHERE excluded.ID = p.ID AND excluded.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM IS NULL, avg_aCL_IgM DESC LIMIT 10
